en.t: It meant, Her jeweled face remains before my eyes, and I cannot forget it.

units.source_text: 然而这些吟咏无人听见。

en.t: Yet no one heard these verses he murmured.

units.source_text: 如此看来，玉鬘离去之事，他到此刻方才确信，此种心理实甚奇怪。

en.t: Seen in this way, it was only at this moment that he finally became convinced that Tamakazura had left, and this state of mind was truly strange.

units.source_text: 他看见这里有许多鸭蛋，便把它们当作柑子或桔子，找个适当的借口，派人送与玉鬘。

en.t: Seeing that there were many duck eggs here, he treated them as if they were citrons or oranges, found a suitable pretext, and sent someone to deliver them to Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 附信一封，深恐别人看见，不宜写得太详，但直率地写道：“一别以来，日月徒增。

en.t: He enclosed a letter, but because he greatly feared that others might see it, he could not write in much detail, and instead wrote frankly: Since our parting, the days and months have only piled up in vain.

units.source_text: 不料如此无情，思之实甚怅恨。

en.t: I never expected such heartlessness, and when I think of it I am filled with sorrow and resentment.

units.source_text: 固知身在樊笼，不能自作自主。

en.t: I know well that you are confined in a cage and cannot decide things for yourself.

units.source_text: 如此看来，非有特殊机缘，难得再图会面，令人不胜惋惜。”

en.t: In that case, unless some special chance arises, it will be hard to hope for another meeting, which fills me with endless regret.
The wording was very tender and intimate.
